description: This file defines a class BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber that subscribes to specific HRM system events related to employee data purging and deletion. It contains event handler methods that trigger adjustments to like and comment counts within the Buzz plugin when such events occur.

classes.name: BuzzAdjustCommentLikeCountSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber class that listens to employee purging and deletion events to update like/comment counts in the Buzz plugin.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping system events to handler method names.

methods.name: onEmployeePurgingEnd
methods.description: Handles the event of employee data purging completion to adjust like and comment counts.

methods.name: onEmployeesDeleted
methods.description: Handles the event of employee deletion to adjust like and comment counts.
